# Dr. Dalia AbdElMougood Zariaa Dental Clinic (عيادة د. داليا عبد الموجود زارع)
> Premier Painless Cosmetic, Implant & Pediatric Dental Clinic in Maadi, Cairo, Egypt.

## About Dr. Dalia
- **Founder & Lead Doctor:** Dr. Dalia AbdElMougood Zariaa (د. داليا عبد الموجود زارع / د. داليا زريع)
- **Title:** Consultant in Oral & Dental Medicine and Surgery (استشاري طب وجراحة الفم والأسنان)
- **Education:** Faculty of Dentistry, Cairo University (Qasr El Ainy) — كلية طب الفم والأسنان جامعة القاهرة (القصر العيني)
- **Clinical Experience:** 20+ Years in advanced restorative, cosmetic, implant, and pediatric dentistry.
- **Philosophy:** 100% painless dentistry with gentle local anesthesia protocols, empathetic patient communication, and cutting-edge digital dentistry.

## Key Services Offered
1. **Painless Dental Implants (زراعة الأسنان بدون ألم):**
   Immediate and conventional titanium fixtures placed using 3D CBCT planning with over 98% success rate and zero patient discomfort.
2. **Hollywood Smile & Porcelain Veneers (ابتسامة هوليود وفينيرز الإيماكس):**
   Custom-milled ultra-thin E-max and Zirconia veneers designed to harmoniously enhance smile aesthetics without unnecessary tooth grinding.
3. **Painless Root Canal Treatment (علاج وحشو العصب بدون ألم):**
   Single-visit rotary endodontic treatments utilizing apex locators and digital imaging to remove infection completely pain-free.
4. **Gentle Pediatric Dentistry (طب أسنان الأطفال بدون خوف):**
   Fear-free, stress-free dental visits tailored for kids with gentle fluoride therapy, pulpotomy, and habit breaking.
5. **Laser Gum Depigmentation & Contouring (توريد وتحديد اللثة بالليزر):**
   Fast, painless cosmetic laser procedures to restore healthy pink gums and correct gummy smiles.
6. **Cosmetic Fillings & Crowns (الحشوات التجميلية وتركيبات الزيركونيا):**
   Tooth-colored composite restorations and high-translucency Zirconia crowns.
